instructions.scope: Offline bounded Dupire conversion and deterministic forward-PDE pricing with explicit boundary assumptions. No downloads, surface refitting or Monte Carlo.
instructions.inputs: run.py passes the current surface result automatically. No ticker, date, archive path or source-selection setting belongs here. Live/historical provenance and timing/curve warnings remain inherited.
instructions.domain: Inherit the surface permission, minimum density and negative-derivative roundoff tolerance. No new permissions: knots, unsupported wings and extrapolation are excluded. An invalid point stays unavailable.
instructions.grid: Numbers of strictly interior time and log-moneyness samples per supported interval. The reusable evaluator reads the original fitted model, not an interpolation of this grid.
instructions.validation: Compare w_T/g with independent normalized-call finite differences at two step sizes. Score = absolute variance difference / (absolute_variance_tolerance + relative_tolerance * maximum absolute compared variance). Every agreement/convergence score must be <= 1. These tolerances are numerical policies, not market-price acceptance thresholds.
instructions.units: Time uses the surface ACT/365F reference; k=log(K/F(T)). Volatility is annualized decimal, variance is annualized decimal squared. Only a negative w_T within the inherited roundoff tolerance may be set to zero and counted explicitly.
instructions.outputs: Immutable local_volatility report, grids, pricing summaries and all quote errors under this processed run. Results retain inherited date/timing warnings. full_simulation_ready remains false: this stage does not implement Monte Carlo.
instructions.pricing: Complete raw-SVI node prices, preserving approved strips. Short end scales first completed total variance by T/T1, reaching the first smile exactly. Wing OTM power mixtures match premium and slope, have positive density and analytically ordered outer tails; core/transition calendar ordering is audited numerically. Local variance comes from the completed prices. Raw-SVI call interpolation is required; unsupported models or infeasible nested joins are blocked. Strict evaluator permissions are unchanged. No extrapolation after last expiry.
instructions.pricing_validation: Price budget = absolute_price_forward_fraction*D*F + relative_price_tolerance*abs(surface target). Both discretization and expanded-grid differences must fit numerical_budget_fraction of that budget. Surface and boundary-policy differences each must fit the full budget; IV errors must satisfy maximum_iv_error (decimal). Every supported quote and all expiries must be assessed. Market comparison uses upstream quality limits and original F,D,tau via stable-IV transport. Numerical budgets are prototype policies, not market standards.
instructions.plots: Self-contained interactive 3D HTML plots show supported patches only, preserving maturity gaps and unbounded original volatility scale. No CDN or external browser requests.
instructions.boundary_calibration: wing_tail_fraction in (0,1) sets a common slow exponent from observed boundary slopes; the remaining exponents/weights are derived to match price/slope and maintain tail ordering. Alternative fraction changes the assumed tails while preserving calibration. short_end_power_alternative in (1,2] changes time allocation while preserving the first-expiry endpoint. boundary_audit_points controls the numerical strike audit, augmented by joins and SVI curvature samples. Legacy wing_transition_width/interior_time_fraction apply only to legacy flat-variance policies.
instructions.pricing_numerics: Calibrated completion uses an exponentially fitted log-strike stencil with harmonic cell-averaged local variance, using three-point Gaussian quadrature split at density joins and their exponential scales. Coarse/refined/wider-grid comparisons still use the unchanged acceptance budgets. Legacy completion uses the original central stencil.
instructions.date_spot_mapping: The integrated state interface uses aware timestamps and positive underlying levels in the surface quote currency. Time zero is the saved option observation, never COB midnight. k=log(S/F(t)); ACT/365F elapsed seconds; saved F,D nodes are reused. Strict domain is the default. Explicit opt-in enables existing calibrated boundary policies, with per-state flags. Base pricing.log_grid_bounds are hard query stops, not path clipping. No time extrapolation, ETF proxy, FX conversion or Monte Carlo. Missing/failed pricing gates block preparation.
